title: Migrate optimizer and task artifacts to GraphQLArtifactStore
description:
Purpose: Remove default AWS credential requirements from optimizer and task artifact paths.

Owned scope:
- Optimizer manifests, event logs, runtime logs, and final artifacts.
- Task output attachments.
- Remaining API-key-only conditionals in optimizer, progress tracking, MCP, and procedure control paths that are part of the local workflow.

Acceptance:
- Optimizer artifacts and task output remain visible through existing dashboard pointers.
- Core-path tests make boto3.client for S3 raise and still pass.
- Existing artifact metadata remains readable.
- No silent storage or authentication fallback remains.
